title: Distributed Sparse Interventions in Language Models
abstract: arXiv:2607.07128v2 Announce Type: replace  Abstract: Language models can perform a wide range of tasks at various levels of abstraction. They flexibly infer tasks from context, execute multiple tasks simultaneously, and select among competing goals. Understanding and controlling how models represent these tasks is central to aligning them with human objectives. Researchers can change model behaviour in many ways, but model steering, which manipulates intermediate task representations, links representation to behaviour most directly. Current steering methods typically intervene densely and assume linear effects, e.g., shifting every activation along a global direction in the residual stream. Because such interventions change thousands of neurons at once, they leave researchers to separate relevant from irrelevant neurons. We introduce Distributed Sparse Interventions (DSI), which steers models through a sparse set of individual neurons distributed across layers and attention heads. Find

translated_title: 语言模型中的分布式稀疏干预
translated_abstract: 语言模型可以在不同的抽象层次上执行各种任务。它们能够灵活地从上下文中推断任务、同时执行多个任务，并在相互冲突的目标之间做出选择。理解和控制模型如何表示这些任务，对于使模型与人类目标保持一致至关重要。研究人员可以通过多种方式改变模型行为，但模型引导——即操纵中间任务表示——是将表示与行为联系起来的最直接方式。当前的引导方法通常采用密集干预并假设线性效应，例如在残差流中沿全局方向移动所有激活值。由于这类干预会同时改变数千个神经元，研究人员不得不自行区分相关神经元与无关神经元。我们提出了分布式稀疏干预（DSI），通过分布在各层和注意力头中的一组稀疏的个体神经元来引导模型。
tldr: 本文提出了分布式稀疏干预（DSI）方法，通过操纵分布于各层和注意力头中的稀疏个体神经元集合来引导语言模型行为，克服了传统密集线性干预同时改变数千个神经元的弊端，更精准地将模型表示与行为联系起来。
en_tdlr: This paper introduces Distributed Sparse Interventions (DSI), which steers language model behavior through a sparse set of individual neurons distributed across layers and attention heads, overcoming the drawbacks of dense linear interventions that alter thousands of neurons at once.
